body.statement: For \(K=2\), \(s_g=3\) for every \(g\), \(r_{3,1}=1\), \(r_{3,2}=2\), and \((c_{1,1},c_{0,1},c_{1,2},c_{0,2})=(1,-1,-1,1)\), independent cluster labels with common probability \(1/2\) are minimax and \(R_{\mathrm{ind}}=R^\star\) for every \(m\), because the label-complement action is transitive on local assignments and preserves the target.
body.justification: A nondegenerate equality regime is a required sanity check on the strict-separation mechanism.
body.gap: The closest unrestricted no-interference results establish independence generally; this proposition isolates the saturation symmetry under which that benchmark survives interference.
body.consumer: Designers with complement-symmetric direct-and-saturation objectives can retain an ordinary independent implementation without sacrificing worst-case risk.
